isekai-lpacl-desc: Adds lightweight page-level ACL management for editing, moving, grants, and subpage operations.
right-isekai-lpacl-admin: Bypass and administer Isekai Lite Page ACL page permissions
right-isekai-lpacl-role-admin: Manage Isekai Lite Page ACL roles
isekai-lpacl-permission-create-subpage-h: Allows creating subpages under this page.
apihelp-isekailpacl-summary: Returns Isekai Lite Page ACL data for pages.
apihelp-isekailpaclconfig-summary: Returns Isekai Lite Page ACL global configuration.
apihelp-isekaipageacl-summary: Writes Isekai Lite Page ACL configuration.
apierror-isekai-lpacl-permissiondenied: You do not have permission to perform this action.
apierror-isekai-lpacl-missingpage: The requested page does not exist.
apierror-isekai-lpacl-badactor: The requested actor does not exist.
apierror-isekai-lpacl-badrole: The requested role does not exist.
apierror-isekai-lpacl-invalidjson: The grants payload is not valid JSON.
isekai-lpacl-edit-denied: You do not have page-level edit permission for this page.
isekai-lpacl-create-subpage-denied: You do not have permission to create a subpage under the target parent page.
isekai-lpacl-move-create-subpage-denied: You cannot move this page to $1 because you do not have permission to create a subpage under the target parent page.
isekai-lpacl-error-missing-target: Please provide an existing target page as a subpage.
isekai-lpacl-error-user-not-found: The specified user does not exist.
isekai-lpacl-error-grant-not-found: The requested permission entry does not exist.
isekai-lpacl-parent-grant-help: These permissions come from $1. Setting permissions below will override the parent page permissions. To revoke the parent permissions for this user, leave all roles and permissions unchecked.
isekai-lpacl-delete-confirm: Are you sure you want to delete the page permissions for $1?
isekai-lpacl-empty-grants: No user permissions have been configured for this page.
isekai-lpacl-role-disable-confirm: Are you sure you want to disable the role $1? Existing grants that reference this role will no longer receive permissions from it.
isekai-lpacl-role-enable-confirm: Are you sure you want to enable the role $1?
isekai-lpacl-role-delete-confirm: Are you sure you want to permanently delete the role $1? Existing page grants that reference this key will keep the key, but it will no longer resolve to a role.
isekai-lpacl-role-key-help: Use lowercase letters, numbers, underscores, and hyphens. The key must start with a lowercase letter.
isekai-lpacl-role-name-message-help: Role names are provided by this interface message:
isekai-lpacl-role-empty-list: No page permission roles have been configured.
isekai-lpacl-role-error-not-found: The requested role does not exist.
isekai-lpacl-special-placeholder: The backend is available. The graphical editor can be connected to this page through ResourceLoader.
isekai-lpacl-role-placeholder: Role management APIs are available. The graphical role editor can be connected here.
isekai-lpacl-permission-grant-help: Allows viewing and changing page ACL settings.
isekai-lpacl-permission-edit-subpage-hel: Allows editing subpages under this page.
isekai-lpacl-permission-move-subpage-hel: Allows moving subpages under this page.
isekai-lpacl-move-denied: You do not have page-level move permission for this page.
